method: Built-in image_gen. Copies of complete native-alpha PNGs, no programmatic image edits or masks.

active_assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / native transparent extraction. The supplied atlas has the APPROVED stone top course with its visible shaded front thickness; preserve that art exactly, INCLUDING its flush non-overhanging front faces.
Remove ONLY the additional dark brick courses beneath each of the SIX horizontal/corner top modules, replacing those lower masonry bricks with genuine transparency. Keep every light cap stone AND its own attached dark front face: these are one complete stone and must not become flat tiles. Retain all L corners and all vertical stones unchanged. Retain exact 1254x1254 canvas, source positions, proportions, complete native outlines and all transparent gutters.
Critical output: independent reusable TOP-COURSE modules with their thickness, ready for separate continuous brick courses immediately below. Their bottom edge must be a thin natural mortar edge, NO chunky black shadow line, NO undercut or ledge, NO recessed feet. Horizontal front faces stay full-width, same approved planar shape. Do not redesign, brighten, add grain or new cracks, do not move anything. The middle large slab remains unchanged. No text, no background.

Precise TEXTURE-ONLY edit. Image 1 is target atlas; image 2 is style reference. Edit ONLY the two middle-left and middle-right vertical two-stone strips in image 1. Their texture is too busy/faceted and too bright compared with the corner stones of image 2.
Repaint their surfaces to EXACTLY match the quieter softer slate-blue surface of image 2's VERTICAL stones attached to the four corners. Keep subtle soft diagonal painted planes, same medium-light slate-blue shade, same restrained rim and same material. Remove excessive granular/cloudy/rock-chip patchwork and large bright white edge. Keep small cracks with understated contrast. Do not alter any outlines, positions, sizes, offsets between stones, joint spacing or shallow edge bevel geometry; keep the small sideways offsets that are present. No broad dark downward face at the bottom.
Preserve the rest of image 1 unchanged. Same canvas and all complete silhouettes. Native transparent background. No text or symbols.

Precise texture-only edit of this brick sprite atlas. Preserve the EXACT 1254x1254 canvas, all eight sprites' positions, dimensions, proportions, entire silhouettes and alpha. They are four rows, each with a long brick on left and a shorter brick on right.
Soften the surface painting: replace gritty mottled spots, sharp repeated brush patches and sponge noise with calm broad softly blended slate-blue-gray planes, in the same painterly style as a smooth dungeon wall. Preserve four subtly different worn/cracked variants and their original medium-dark blue shade. Quiet upper-left rim, dark lower-right edge; no shiny white outline, no material change. Do NOT move, resize, shorten, flatten, replace or add any brick. No background, no labels. Genuine transparency. This is ONLY an interior color/texture edit, all geometry is locked.

active_assets.status: Unchanged approved variants; existing per-tile RGB modulation multiplied by(1.74,1.61,1.40), alpha1. Geometry, seed173, texture and placement preserved.

assembly: Continuous independent lower masonry courses across entire horizontal spans, including corner footprints. Upper course y88, lower y88+upper height-2. Complete sprites, native proportions, uniform scaling. Side native offsets plus [0,3,-2,1] source-pixel placement; RGB1.08. Masonry RGB1.10.
